top_signals.title: ‘Always Remain Liquid’: Richards
top_signals.summary: Bruce Richards, managing partner and head of CVC Marathon, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on “Bloomberg Money.” They discuss Richards’ favorite investing advice he has received throughout his career. Richards warns about irrational markets and also says he’s not a fan of leveraged ETF structures. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump Says Huang Should Return to Nvidia After ‘Big Apology’
top_signals.summary: President Trump called for Jensen Huang to make a big apology and return as CEO of Nvidia even as the prospect remains highly unlikely.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Anthropic Slides 8.5% to Shrink IPO Gain as AI Trade Unravels
top_signals.summary: Anthropic PBC shares erased a portion of their first-day jump on Friday, testing investors’ faith after the AI lab delivered the biggest initial public offering in history.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
